# Library

The Library stores learner records: uploaded files, pasted notes and saved
links.

## Upload

1. `POST /api/records/upload-url` with `{ name, mime, size }`.
2. PUT the bytes to the returned `uploadUrl`.
3. `POST /api/records` with `kind: "upload"`, `fileKey`, `name`, `mime` and
   `size`.

Regular records are capped at 500 MB. The Supabase fallback is capped at 5 MB.

## Extraction

Scanned PDFs and images may use OCR; text PDFs and Office files use their text
layer; audio/video can be transcribed. Poll
`GET /api/records/extract/status?recordId=...` with backoff.

## Ask

`POST /api/records/ask` with `{ recordId, question }` returns an answer with
citations. Do not ask before the record is searchable; `409` means extraction is
still running.

## Limits

- 200 records per shelf.
- Folder covers: images up to 5 MB.
- Ownership is enforced; a `fileKey` from another learner is rejected.
